snippet.title: Origament: A Paper Adventure - Official Demo Release Date Trailer | The MIX Fall Game Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Watch the latest Origament: A Paper Adventure trailer for this upcoming chill 3D puzzle-platformer where you play as a special letter with a soul. It’s trying to find its way to the address, traveling through eras and countries inhabited by strange creatures. Origament: A Paper Adventure will be available on PC and consoles, and a demo will be available on Steam on September 24, 2025.
